messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PAGER FIRED — High 5xx rate on inference-gateway-prod. metric: 5xx_rate=4.8% (10m) > threshold 2.0%. affected route: /v1/embeddings, region: eu-west1. PD: https://redwood.pd/INC12345. please acknowledge.
ryan: Acked on PagerDuty. I'm on it — moving to this thread.
santiago: jumping in, grabbing logs now.
maya: Noted. Oncall — do we have any customer impact yet?
ryan: Some failed embedding calls reported by a few customers. Error budget flagging, will triage.
santiago: quick tail shows upstream 502s from model-worker eu-west1-a. snippet: ```2026-03-17T02:34:12Z upstream_error 502 "KV cache stall: miss storm"``` looks like cache eviction thrash.
ryan: Can we divert traffic to a fallback model variant while we stabilize? proposing quick traffic slice shift.
charlie: +1 for reroute. Keep it small and observable.
santiago: applied a canary reroute command: `redwood route update --service inference-gateway --route /v1/embeddings --weights model-v2=0.3,model-v1=0.7` — rolling out.
incident-bot: Automated action recorded: traffic weights updated by ryan (change-id r456). new weights: model-v2=30%, model-v1=70%.
maya: Any immediate change in 5xx numbers?
santiago: 5xx rate now 3.1% (5m window). trending down but still above threshold. continuing observation.
ryan: spun up 2 extra gateway pods in eu-west1: `kubectl scale deploy/gateway --replicas=8 -n inference` — replicas increased, pods healthy.
jessica: model-workers in eu-west1 reported CPU spike and a couple of OOMs earlier — logs show frequent KV evictions. likely cache size + concurrency mismatch.
santiago: bumping KV cache for workers: rolling update with `REDWOOD_KV_CACHE_MB=1024` env — rolling restart started.
incident-bot: PD INC12345 status: acknowledged -> investigating. (manual close required)
maya: Customer Impact update: top 10 EU customers saw ~0.6% failed embedding requests during the peak window; some experienced retries/latency. CS is notified and monitoring.
ryan: error rate now 1.5% (5m) — below threshold and stable for last 3m. keeping PD open until daytime SRE picks up. follow-ups: tune cache defaults, add guardrail in runbook, consider autoscale policy bump.
charlie: 👍 added runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kvcache-eviction
santiago: marking timeline for postmortem and follow-up action items. handing off to daytime SRE at 08:00 UTC.
ryan: thanks all. I'll update INC12345 and leave notes for follow-up. closing this thread when daytime confirms.
